scientific_integrity: Explicit all-n proof; no claim of independent verification, priority certainty, or exact homeomorphism for the unretracted quotient.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the open neighborhood complex of C_n^2 only for n>=9 and ordinary dihedral orbit space; no Borel equivariant assertion.
title: A sphere quotient and equivariant torus retraction for square-cycle neighborhood complexes
